checked_decisions.finding: Correct tail lines of resource 2821040 (Power Golem / Asuham Boone), continuing the boastful/commanding voice used in batch_15284.json before the Dominator block begins.

Cynthia Lane's whimsical, game-obsessed register ('New game, start!', 'Game Over', 'Continue', teasing 'as expected, I could love you!') matches character_names_021.json ('Whimsical; treats everything as a game; candy-loving'); katakana loanwords for game vocabulary map cleanly onto the English gaming terms.

Several lines shift the source's third-person plural (あいつら/どいつもこいつも, 'them/those guys') to direct second-person address ('you all', 'you small-timers'). Unlike row 15335 in the previous batch, here the referent is unambiguously the group Cynthia is actively fighting (the newly-arrived reinforcements she is taunting face to face), so the person shift does not change who is being addressed; no fix needed.

'ゲイナー君' (Gainer-kun) rendered plainly as 'Gainer', dropping the diminutive suffix; matches the locked pilot name (Gainer Sanga, en_short 'Gainer') and Cynthia's established online-gaming-friend relationship with him per character_names_021.json. No nickname invented.

Resource boundary at row 15439 correctly identified as the start of 2821120 (Emperanza-Gachiko / Gain Bijou) per shout_groups.json; only 5 rows fall in this slice, remainder continues in batch_15444.json.

Idiom 'お礼参り' rendered as 'thank-you visit' (ironic retaliation) preserves Gain's dry, wisecracking tone rather than flattening to plain 'revenge'; 'Yapan' reused from the locked 'Yapan Exodus' usage in character_names_021.json / terms_028.json.
